tasks.title: Announcement #18
tasks.instruction: Listen to a teacher talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: At the discretion of the campus police and in accordance with standard security policies, students will no longer be required to show their school ID cards in the school cafeteria. We hope that this change will make your dining experience more pleasant as some students who forgot to bring their ID card have been refused to eat in there, and we want to change that.

questions.stem: What is the subject of the announcement?

options.A: Canceling of a rule in the cafeteria

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这则通知的主题是什么，属于主旨/话题识别题，需抓住老师整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 通知明确说“students will no longer be required to show their school ID cards in the school cafeteria”，即取消了在食堂出示学生证的要求，这是对一项旧规则的取消。 选项B：错误。 通知中提到的是学生证，但并未涉及更换新学生证，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 通知说明了食堂规则的变化，但并未解释如何使用食堂，属于偏离主旨。 选项D：错误。 通知取消了一项要求，而非增加新要求，属于与原文意思相反。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about cafeteria?

options.A: Students without school ID cards can no longer have meals in it.
options.B: It will change its dining hours.
options.C: Students had to eat outside if they lost their school ID card.
options.D: Students working in it must follow standard security policies.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于食堂可以推断出什么，属于推理判断题，需根据通知中的信息进行合理推断。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知说学生不再需要出示学生证，因此没带学生证的学生现在可以在食堂用餐，与选项意思相反。 选项B：错误。 通知中没有提到食堂营业时间的改变，属于无中生有。 选项C：正确。 通知提到“some students who forgot to bring their ID card have been refused to eat in there”，说明之前没带学生证的学生无法在食堂用餐，即如果丢了学生证就得去外面吃。 选项D：错误。 通知提到“in accordance with standard security policies”，但并未说明在食堂工作的学生必须遵守这些政策，属于张冠李戴。
